body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself and one ally within 5 units. The first time either gains Rallied, +1 Defense, or +1 die before your next turn, the other gains the same benefit at half duration.

surges.html: Mark one affected creature; the next Psionics Action you use against it gains 1 free Surge, then remove the mark.
Remove one Physical damage Condition from yourself or an ally affected by this card.

rider.title: RESONANCE — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, the first shared benefit is not consumed when copied.
